description: This script generates various name constraints and subject alternative names for testing certificate generation, including functions for encoding names, IP ranges, and generating test certificates with different constraints.

classes.name: SubjectAltNameGenerator
classes.description: Class for generating Subject Alternative Name extensions with multiple names.

classes.name: NameConstraintsGenerator
classes.description: Class for creating name constraints with permitted and excluded subtrees.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a certificate extension file with specified name constraints or subject alternative names.

methods.name: other_name
methods.description: Creates a generic 'otherName' ASN.1 structure with a random identifier.

methods.name: rfc822_name
methods.description: Returns an RFC822 email name in ASN.1 format.

methods.name: dns_name
methods.description: Returns a DNS name in ASN.1 format.

methods.name: x400_address
methods.description: Creates an X.400 address ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: directory_name
methods.description: Converts a directory name object to ASN.1 format.

methods.name: edi_party_name
methods.description: Creates an EDI party name ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: uniform_resource_identifier
methods.description: Returns a URI in ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ip_address
methods.description: Returns an IP address in ASN.1 format, with optional enforcement of length.

methods.name: ip_address_range
methods.description: Returns an IP address range in ASN.1 format with netmask, enforcing length if specified.

methods.name: registered_id
methods.description: Returns a registered object identifier in ASN.1 format.

methods.name: with_min_max
methods.description: Adds minimum and maximum constraints to a value in ASN.1 format.
